planets.name: Kepler-974 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-974 with a 4.19-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-974 b was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-974. Its orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
